content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 5 reactions for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have guidance: steps enumerated forward: TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H reduction, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari etc. But we need retrosynthetic steps (reverse). So we need to break down target into precursors via 5 steps.

We need to construct JSON route with nested reactions and molecules.

We need to find appropriate template IDs for each step. We have one template from search: reaction_id 29646 with retro_smarts_template that converts protected alcohol to alcohol? Actually retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]' This is forward? The retro template indicates breaking TBS? It says [C:2]-[OH] >> C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So forward reaction would be protection: alcohol + TBSCl -> TBS ether. So retro step would be deprotection: remove TBS to give alcohol. So we can use that for step where we deprotect.

Our target has multiple OH groups? The SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. Contains a free OH at start (O attached to chiral carbon). Also an O-alkyl (O[C@@H]...). That O is an ether linking to side chain with unsaturated chain and terminal COOH. So maybe we need to protect that OH earlier.

We need 5 steps: maybe 1) deprotect TBS to give alcohol (if target has TBS? but target doesn't have TBS). Actually target has free OH, not protected. So maybe earlier step had TBS protection that later removed. In retrosynthesis, we go from target to earlier precursor by removing protecting group (i.e., add TBS). So step 1: apply reverse of deprotection: add TBS to the free OH to get TBS-protected intermediate.

Thus we need a template that adds TBS: forward is protection, retro is deprotection. The template we have does deprotection (reverse). So to go from target to precursor, we apply the retro direction? Actually apply_template uses forward direction (retro template applied to target to give precursors). The retro_smarts_template is for retrosynthesis: it maps product to reactants. So using apply_template with target SMILES and template_id (reaction_id) will give precursors (i.e., protected version). So we can use template_id 29646.

Let's test apply_template to see precursors.
